g.text: Benny System — Cloud-Native High-Throughput Architecture (.NET 10 / C# 14 / ASP.NET Core 10)
Real-Time Financial Transaction, Risk Intelligence & Petabyte Telemetry Platform
1. Edge & Ingress Layer — Why: Single Secure Entry Point & Traffic Shield
2. Multi-Tier Low-Latency Cache (<1ms) — Why: Offload Databases & Guarantee Sub-Millisecond Lookups
3. Core Microservices Mesh — Why: Decoupled Fast-Path Write (<15ms P99) & CQRS Read Separation
4. ACID Ledger & Durable Event Backbone — Why: Zero Data Loss & Asynchronous Decoupling
5. Polyglot Big Data Layer — Why: Purpose-Built Storage Engines for Massive Data Volumes
6. Cloud-Native Observability & Autoscaling Control Plane — Why: Self-Healing & Elastic Scale
Role: API Gateway, Auth & Traffic Throttling
: Eliminates network hops on hot reads
and Pub/Sub invalidation for L1 caches
before any money or state is committed
tenant rule graphs & geo/amount anomalies in <5ms
deduplication, orchestrates Risk check -> Ledger commit
Role: Dedicated Read-Only API for Dashboards
so they never slow down live transaction writes
Role: System of Record for Financial Balances
and zero lost events (no dual-write bugs)
account balance debit/credit, atomic Outbox event write
fast OLTP writes from heavy downstream analytics
Role: Async Event Consumer & Polyglot Router
: Transforms raw event streams into analytical
projections and fans out bulk writes in parallel
and AI/ML fraud model training over Parquet files
: Handles millions of raw write IOPS
: Scans billions of rows in milliseconds
: Live tenant revenue, P95/P99 risk scores,
• End-to-end W3C TraceContext propagation across HTTP & Kafka
• Prometheus RED/USE metrics, .NET 10 Server GC stats & structured logs
: Scales stateless API pods (3 -> 100+) on RPS, CPU & P99 latency
: Scales Stream Processor pods (3 -> 64) on Kafka Consumer Lag
